# 全球南方崛起：藝術世界的新主導力量

## The Global South takes center stage in the art world: Could its cultural hegemony reshape geopolitics?

> **摘要 / Summary**：全球南方的崛起正在改變藝術世界的格局，南方國家的文化影響力日益增強，將可能重塑全球政治格局。
> *The rise of the Global South is changing the art world, with the cultural influence of southern countries growing, potentially reshaping geopolitics.*

**The Global South takes center stage in the art world: Could its cultural hegemony reshape geopolitics?**

The rise of the Global South is changing the art world, with the cultural influence of southern countries growing, potentially reshaping geopolitics. This trend is not only a change in the art world, but also a challenge to the traditional dominance of the North. The growing cultural influence of southern countries will likely reshape the global political landscape, challenging the traditional dominance of the North. The rise of the Global South also brings new opportunities and challenges to the art world, and artists and curators need to adapt to this change, finding new ways to create and showcase their work to meet the cultural demands and market changes of southern countries. At the same time, the rise of the Global South reminds us that art is not only a creation, but also a cultural expression and political expression, and artists and curators need to pay attention to the changes in global politics, and the cultural demands and market changes of southern countries, in order to create truly influential artworks. The rise of the Global South is a topic that needs attention and consideration, and the art world needs to actively respond to this change, finding new ways to create and showcase their work to meet the cultural demands and market changes of southern countries. At the same time, the rise of the Global South also brings us a new topic to think about: how will the future of global politics change, how will the cultural influence of southern countries reshape the global political landscape, and how will the art world respond to this change, creating truly influential artworks.
